name: Cursor
summary: A code editor with AI built in. Its agent can read and change files in the folders you open, and run commands in the terminal.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open Cursor > Settings > Cursor Settings. Turn off auto-run for terminal commands and remove tool connections (MCP) you do not use. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Cursor > Settings > Cursor Settings. Turn off auto-run for terminal commands and remove tool connections (MCP) you do not use. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: Windsurf
summary: A code editor (and editor extension) with AI built in. Its agent can read and change files in the folders you open, and run commands.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open Windsurf Settings and turn off auto-execution of commands. Remove tool connections (MCP) you do not use. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Windsurf Settings and turn off auto-execution of commands. Remove tool connections (MCP) you do not use. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's AI coding tool. It can read and change files in the folder it runs in and run commands, asking for permission unless you have allowed them in advance.

howToTurnOff.windows: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. Remove saved permissions and tool connections with the /permissions and /mcp commands inside Claude Code.
howToTurnOff.mac: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Cmd+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. Remove saved permissions and tool connections with the /permissions and /mcp commands inside Claude Code.

name: GitHub Copilot
summary: An AI coding assistant for code editors. It reads the code you are working on, and in agent mode it can change files and run commands after you approve them.

howToTurnOff.windows: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Cmd+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall.

name: Cline
summary: An AI coding agent extension. It can read and change files and run commands. If auto-approve is switched on it does this without asking.

howToTurnOff.windows: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. In Cline's settings, switch off auto-approve.
howToTurnOff.mac: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Cmd+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. In Cline's settings, switch off auto-approve.

name: Roo Code
summary: An AI coding agent extension. It can read and change files and run commands. If auto-approve is switched on it does this without asking.

howToTurnOff.windows: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. In Roo Code's settings, switch off auto-approve.
howToTurnOff.mac: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Cmd+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall. In Roo Code's settings, switch off auto-approve.

howToTurnOff.mac: In VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf, open the Extensions view (Cmd+Shift+X), find the extension and select Disable or Uninstall.
